El Cañaveral — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

El Canaveral has extensive and very recent (2025-2026) documented coverage of serious organised crime: a robbery wave by the so-called 'banda de la alcantarilla' (July 2025) that led residents to demand a local police station, and multiple reports (November 2025 onward) of the Venezuelan organised-crime group 'Tren de Aragua' establishing a base in the neighbourhood involving occupied flats, drug production and prostitution, described by ABC as turning the development into 'la urbanizacion maldita' (the cursed development). Thirteen arrests were reported in one related operation. Sources checked: Antena3, 23 Jul 2025; LaSexta, 22 Jul 2025; ABC, 19 Nov 2025 ('urbanizacion maldita'); gaceta.es, 18 Nov 2025 (Tren de Aragua); Telemadrid, 8 Nov 2025; ABC, 15 Feb 2026.
